static_negative.result: the unattended passive board does not fold the towel

status_text.zh: 暴露图：裤子覆盖整件衬衫；裤子暂存路线的连续候选启动后由作者暂停（400 步）；衬衫翻折子技能仅在单件衬衫诊断场景完成；无完整物理证据
status_text.en: Exposure map: pants cover the whole shirt; the pants-staging continuous candidate was launched and paused by the author (400 steps); the shirt flip-fold sub-skill is complete only in a single-shirt diagnostic scene; no complete physical evidence

detail.zh: 暴露图显示初始衣堆中裤子覆盖整件衬衫，左手没有仅含衬衫的夹点；路线已改为先暂存裤子、双手捏袖（v2）。连续候选 pile2-full-l2-50 于 15:13 启动，执行 400 个物理步后由作者于 15:39 暂停。衬衫翻折子技能在单件衬衫诊断场景首次完成原生整折（模板 rms 12.5 mm、最大 34.7 mm、高度 50.6 mm；折层间距 62.3 mm 超出 55 mm 搬运上限），不属于衣堆证据。无完整物理证据，未验收。
detail.en: The exposure map shows the pants covering the whole shirt in the seeded pile, with no shirt-only pinch site for the left hand; the route was changed to stage the pants first and pinch both sleeves (v2). The continuous candidate pile2-full-l2-50 was launched at 15:13 and paused by the author at 15:39 after 400 physics steps. The shirt flip-fold sub-skill completed its first native full fold in a single-shirt diagnostic scene (template rms 12.5 mm, max 34.7 mm, height 50.6 mm; layer separation 62.3 mm exceeds the 55 mm carry limit); this is not pile evidence. No complete physical evidence; not accepted.

status_text.zh: 场景初始化、初始谓词成立（seed 1103）；控制器仅为骨架（400 步后暂停）；无物理证据
status_text.en: Scene initialises and the initial predicate holds (seed 1103); skeleton controller only (paused after 400 steps); no physics evidence

detail.zh: 场景已初始化（seed 1103，2,000 步准备，初始谓词 seeded_sorting_initial 成立）；组合控制器仅为骨架，骨架运行在双手接近阶段执行 400 步后暂停。错层、缠连、滑脱恢复及裤子／袜子折叠均无物理原语。无物理证据，未验收。
detail.en: The scene initialises (seed 1103, 2,000 preparation steps, initial predicate seeded_sorting_initial holds); the composed controller is a skeleton only, and its run was paused after 400 steps during the bimanual approach. Wrong-layer, tangle and slip recovery and the pants/sock folds have no physical primitive. No physics evidence; not accepted.

status_text.zh: 托盘停靠楔卡已诊断并移除、不可达毛巾站已迁移；完整候选在衬衫抓取失败（lost_material_support，40.02 mm > 40 mm）；改配置候选启动后暂停（700 步）
status_text.en: Tray-dock wedge diagnosed and removed, unreachable towel station relocated; the full candidate failed at shirt capture (lost_material_support, 40.02 mm vs 40 mm); the re-configured candidate was paused (700 steps)

detail.zh: 托盘抬升失败诊断为停靠挡块楔卡（托盘偏转 0.0166 rad 卡在角挡之间），已移除停靠；毛巾站按构造不可达（左升降达 70 N 上限、短 140 mm），已迁移为单层布局。完整候选 pack-full-level-64 从原始初态执行 12,300 步，在衬衫抓取处失败（lost_material_support，锚点位移 40.02 mm，容差 40 mm；机理为原生 V 形夹口在硬折层上的抖动棘轮）。改配置候选 pack2-full-66 于 15:30 启动，700 步后由作者暂停；其静止对照 pack2-negative-67 通过。未验收。
detail.en: The tray-lift failure was diagnosed as a dock-stop wedge (tray yawed 0.0166 rad between the corner stops) and the dock was removed; the towel station, unreachable by construction (left lift at the 70 N cap, 140 mm short), was relocated to a single-level layout. The full candidate pack-full-level-64 ran 12,300 steps from the original initial state and failed at shirt capture (lost_material_support, anchor motion 40.02 mm against a 40 mm tolerance; mechanism: chatter ratchet of the native V-jaw on the stiff fold). The re-configured candidate pack2-full-66 was launched at 15:30 and paused by the author after 700 steps; its static negative pack2-negative-67 passed. Not accepted.

status_text.zh: 场景初始化、初始谓词成立（seed 1202）；箱体从默认基座不可达；控制器仅为骨架（400 步后暂停）；无物理证据

detail.en: The scene initialises (seed 1202, 1,200 preparation steps, initial predicate unfolded_packing_initial holds); the packing case is unreachable from the default bases: the lowest collision-free pad height is 0.13–0.17 m above the case floor, above the 0.071 m lid clearance, and flat garments on the table cannot be pinched at cloth level. The controller is a skeleton only (paused after 400 steps). No physics evidence; not accepted.
